snippet.title: Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
🌙 Bobo's twisted carnival is expanding beyond PC! Prepare to jump, glide, and purge your worst nightmares on PC (Steam), Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch when the gates unlock on October 30th, 2026. 

✨ PLAY THE DEMO NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/456140
🌐 Visit the Official Website: https://polycastlabs.com
💬 Meet the Developer: https://discord.gg/X37kwcXCQk

🃏 ABOUT THE GAME 
Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares is a character-driven 3D Collectathon platformer that mixes fluid acrobatics, light combat, and secret-hunting inside a twisted carnival of dreams. Inspired by 1999 golden-era classics like Spyro the Dragon, MediEvil, and Crash Bandicoot, this solo-developed passion project brings back the tight movement and low-poly gothic charm you thought was lost forever.

👍 Like this video, leave a comment with your favorite platform, and subscribe for more dev updates!
